args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing
deeply nested arrays. Affects fastjson <2.9.4; fixed in 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected range is `<2.9.4`; 2.9.4 is the fixed version.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**

## Request
Requesting review from @alex (code owner approval required to merge into main).
